desc:
🔍 Hide and Seek mixed with block building.
🏠 Build your base and hide in it.

One player gets chosen as the seeker during the "hide and seek" phase.

All builds must be appropriate for Roblox.

Premium benefit: get twice as many coins when you find someone as the seeker.
